name.description: New document filename stem (moves the file and changes its path and identity)

bin_id.description: MGFX bin placement is managed by the server: null/absent creates or reuses the root-level mgfx bin

content.description: Live authored source directory and relative entry

entry.description: Relative entry file inside the authored source directory

resources_path.description: Optional saved local resource package, separate from the live source directory; when omitted, the source directory's assets.json is used

source_path.description: Live authored directory: relative to the project bundle or an absolute external path

oneOf.description: Retired for generate.graphics: MGFX renders no artifact and this destination is rejected with mgfx_artifacts_destination_retired. Use the timeline arm for a live MGFX placement.
Direct generation clip placement; track omission is preferred and selects the immediate-upper video lane

at.description: Exactly one seconds-preferred or frame-exact absolute/anchored placement form

offset_seconds.description: Preferred wall-clock offset; quantized to the parent timeline's rational frame rate with nearest/ties-away-from-zero

offset_frames.description: Frame-exact alternative for callers already doing frame math

anchor_clip_id.description: Parent-timeline anchor clip id; offset may be signed

offset_seconds.description: Preferred wall-clock offset; quantized to the parent timeline's rational frame rate with nearest/ties-away-from-zero

anchor_clip_id.description: Parent-timeline anchor clip id; offset may be signed

offset_frames.description: Frame-exact alternative for callers already doing frame math

track.description: Optional workflow lane; omission uses the deterministic immediate-upper video-track policy

oneOf.description: One-based user-facing video lane (1=V1, 2=V2); missing lanes are created in the same transaction

expect_revision.description: Exact current bundle revision; re-verified at commit time so a concurrent edit becomes a clean stale_revision

parameters.description: Controls-first authoring declaration (profile identity, descriptors, initial values); validated in full by the canonical admission gate

placement_mode.description: Timeline placement contract. Omitted/null preserves the v1 legacy compound response; current clients should request direct_generation for a bare MGFX clip and the v2 discriminated response. The legacy default remains supported throughout the v2 compatibility window; changing that default requires a new public schema version.

render.description: The graphic's own raster and duration, read by live placement; omitted raster/fps resolve from the project manifest and the resolved values are persisted verbatim

format.description: Ignored; MGFX renders no artifact. Accepted for compatibility

fps.description: Rational frame rate; defaults from the project manifest when omitted

node_id.description: Durable graph node id as canonical signed int32 decimal string

rerun.description: Start Analyze again even though a job for the node's current key has already finished; without it a call reports that job's state

paths.description: Absolute paths to the media files to register (not .wiz bundles)

require_exact_revision.description: When true, expect_revision must equal the current autosave bundle_version exactly. This opts snapshot-derived multicam publication out of the default per-clip/disjoint-edit semantics

bundle.description: Optional .wiz bundle path scoping this op's path confinement to that bundle's registered media roots (#839); the op stays project-less and never opens the bundle

category.description: Media category override: exr_image, camera_raw_video, raw_still, video, still, or unknown; omitted/empty defaults to video (camera_raw_video for a camera RAW video path)

config_path.description: Absolute OCIO config path for config_source ui/env; omitted for builtin

config_source.description: Color config source: builtin, ui, or env (default builtin)

declared_interop_id.description: Optional Color Interop Forum id of the declared space, e.g. 'srgb_rec709_display'; lets a config that spells the space differently still validate the declaration

declared_name.description: Optional producer declaration of the encoding (OCIO name, e.g. 'sRGB - Display'); validated against the config, never trusted verbatim — an unvalidated declaration falls through to detection

declared_producer.description: Optional token naming who declared it (diagnostic; becomes match_source 'declared:<producer>')

default_policy.description: 'none' (default) or 'per_category': when nothing resolves, apply Wizard's per-category default (video -> Rec.1886/Rec.709 display, still -> sRGB display), returned with provenance 'defaulted'

path.description: Absolute path to the media file to inspect (not a .wiz bundle)

bundle.description: Optional .wiz bundle path scoping this op's path confinement to that bundle's registered media roots (#839); the op stays project-less and never opens the bundle

color_policy.description: Decoded-pixel color policy: source (default, preserves the source encoding) or presentation_srgb (color-managed SDR sRGB pixels for unprofiled image delivery; fails closed when source color cannot be resolved by Wizard's normal input-color detection)

keyframe_tolerance.description: Seconds each timestamp may move to the nearest keyframe, which skips the GOP walk to an exact frame. 0 (default) decodes exact frames; backends without a keyframe index always decode exact frames

max_decode_threads.description: Software decoder thread cap. Omitting the field decodes on a single thread, so background sampling cannot claim the whole decode budget while the editor is playing back; pass 0 to opt into wiz-media's default cap instead

output.description: Absolute path for packed raw RGBA file frames and any IOSurface fallbacks

output_height.description: Optional output height in pixels; 0 with output_width 0 means source height

output_width.description: Optional output width in pixels; 0 with output_height 0 means source width

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing output file (default false)

path.description: Absolute path to the source media file (not a .wiz bundle)

pixel_format.description: File-frame pixel format: native (default) or rgba8 for compact analysis pixels

surface_policy.description: IOSurface decode policy: legacy_gpu_only (default) or gpu_preferred_all

timestamps.description: Strictly ascending source timestamps in seconds to decode, 1..512 per call

transport.description: Frame buffer transport: file (default) or iosurface. IOSurface returns machine-wide lookup handles and is restricted to trusted local workstation clients

mode.description: Timeline preview resolution while playing or scrubbing, the same setting as the viewer's selector: 'full' (no reduction), 'auto', 'half', 'quarter', or 'eighth'

limit.description: Maximum matches for inventory scope; not accepted for timelines

id.description: Stable Media Bin Smart Bin identity

scope.description: Inventory or placed timeline content to search

bin_id.description: Concrete current-bin identity; 'root' addresses the implicit root

recursive.description: V1 searches direct bin membership only

items.description: Registered project asset included in an explicit scope

timeline_ids.description: Omitted selects all timelines; empty selects none

target_kind.description: Target kind: 'native_param' (default) or 'insert_param' (built-in EQ/compressor parameter, values in native units — Hz, dB, ms)

target_path.description: Registered track property id from the track binding table (e.g. 'gain_db'), or with target_kind='insert_param' a built-in insert path: eq.band.<0-5>.{freq_hz,q,gain_db} or comp.{threshold_db,ratio,attack_ms,release_ms,makeup_db}

time.description: Exact timeline time, kept as given; wins over time_sec

sub.description: Exact remainder past the whole frame

time_sec.description: Timeline time in seconds (frame-snapped at the timeline rate)
